description: Individual entries for five Timber Heart varieties.

entries.title: Aurora Timber Heart
entries.summary: An aurora-lit tree supplies elemental heartwood, rejuvenating sap, and chiming leaves.
body: High magical forests support this shifting-color variety. Its wood serves staves and wands, while sap counters magical exhaustion. Defensive illusions and nesting sky elementals protect the core.

entries.title: Ironbark Timber Heart
entries.summary: Steel-hard storm trees produce fire- and lightning-resistant lumber and mineral-rich healing sap.
body: Ironbark roots anchor islands against severe winds, making the wood valuable for armor, weapons, and reinforced airships. Storm-generated electromagnetic pulses disrupt devices, while acidic root sap corrodes tools.

entries.title: Twilight Timber Heart
entries.summary: A black-leaved ley-line tree stores necrotic energy used in shadowcraft and controversial preservation rites.
body: Violet veins glow near ruins and magical lines while the tree absorbs ambient magic into a zone of stillness. Undead and shadow entities gather nearby, and defensive pulses drain intruders' vitality.

entries.title: Sundrop Timber Heart
entries.summary: A radiant golden tree provides permanent light, burn-healing sap, and warming morale tea.
body: Sun-drenched groves cultivate heartwood used to illuminate ships and settlements. Its glow attracts drakes and light-seeking predators, while prolonged exposure can cause heat injury.

entries.title: Verdant Timber Heart
entries.summary: A flexible living tree forms island bridges, shelters ecosystems, and accelerates crop growth.
body: Spring-like heartwood serves tools and weapons while growth-promoting sap aids sky farmers. Expanding roots can damage docks and settlements, and blooming pheromones attract aggressive herbivores.
